title: fix(metadata)!: the boot priming pass hands an unbundled slotted type's row on stamped with its row's package, so a save never inserts a package-less row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgX8948imu1CnX9e7fkiZN3b)_
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cam3nsiJUk5z9eT3PA

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：启动预载时，`agent`、`skill`、`action`、`api`、`permission` 这五类按包存放的元数据，凡是只靠 `package_id` 列绑定到包的数据库行，交给注册时都盖上该行自己的包；保存时如果正文和行只差这枚自包戳，就不写库。`email_template` 早在 #32214 里这么做了，这次补齐其余五类。
- 为什么改：之前这类行进注册表时不带包，落进“无包”槽。两个包都有同名项时，读 A 包会拿到 B 包的正文；有地方再把它存回库，还会多插一条无包行，之后两个包的精确读都变 409（ADR-0150 D4，史诗 #31527）。
- 风险与回滚：只有自己接 `DatabaseLoader` 的宿主会碰到，仓库内没有组合接它，第一方调用方 0。有一处收窄（BREAKING）：点名一个并不持有该名的包去读，原来拿到别的包的正文，现在什么也拿不到；其余变动都是纠正归属。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：下方 FROM → TO 表；`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts` 的 `loadMany` 和新函数 `withLoaderEntryPackages`（只在正文的 `name` 等于本行的键、且同名正文只有一个时盖戳）；`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts` 的 `save` 里 `onlyBoundStampAdded` 那一行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/loaders/database-loader.test.ts -t 32458`，预期 23 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32458

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — on a host that wires a `DatabaseLoader` (none in the workspace), after the boot priming pass a `MetadataManager.get(type, name, packageId)` of an `agent`, `skill`, `action` (object-less), `api` or `permission` whose name is held by stored rows bound to their packages by the `package_id` column alone, naming a package that holds no row of the name (the host's own `packageId` included), answers nothing, where it served another package's body. Every other moved answer corrects an attribution and refuses nothing (table below).
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no key, value or type an author writes moves, and no skill or doc teaches what `MetadataManager.get` answers after a boot over a `DatabaseLoader`.

`Metadata-protocol: none` because no key, value, requirement or type a metadata author writes moves; only what the manager answers after a boot does (the #29029 precedent).

**Narrowing: yes.** First-party callers: **0**. `MetadataManager` wires a `DatabaseLoader` only through `config.driver`, `setDatabaseDriver` or `setDataEngine`, and no package, app or example in the workspace calls them (`git grep` at this head).

## What changes

This applies #31699's shape (PR #32214, already in place for `email_template`) to every type stored per `(package, name)`, as the card's ruling says. The types are taken from the tree: `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` less the bundled ones, so `api`, `agent`, `skill`, `action` and `permission`. Three changes:

1. `MetadataManager.loadMany` stamps a body of an unbundled slotted type that names no package with the package the loader's keyed entry carries for its name (`withLoaderEntryPackages`, then `withEntryPackage`), and only when that entry's own body carries the entry's key as its `name` and no other body in that same loader's `loadMany` answer carries that `name` (the count is per loader; a file-system body of the same name does not stop it, and the manager's by-name dedupe then keeps whichever loader answered first, as on `main`). A body whose `name` is another row's key, or that has none, is never stamped, so no body is handed on with a package its row is not bound to. Every body the loader's `loadMany` answers is kept, in order; a body the keyed read cannot name (a nested or extension-less file, a row whose `name` column is empty) stays as it was. Only a loader that holds items per package (`loadManySlots`) is read a second time, so a file-system loader is not touched. A bundled type keeps #32214's keyed path unchanged.
2. `DatabaseLoader.loadManyKeyed` entries carry the row's `packageId` for every slotted type. Before, only a bundled type's entries did. The entries are otherwise unchanged: one per name for an unbundled type, the row saved last.
3. `DatabaseLoader.save`: a body that differs from its row only by a `_packageId` stamp naming that row's own package writes nothing (`onlyBoundStampAdded`), for every slotted type. Before, it did this only for a bundled type.

The docs drift check named `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`, which says `loadManyKeyed`'s `data` is exactly what `loadMany` returns. That stopped holding for `email_template` with #32214 and now holds for none of the slotted types, so the page gains one sentence: `loadMany` hands a column-bound row on stamped with its package, and `loadManyKeyed` returns the body as stored. `content/docs/protocol/kernel/metadata-service.mdx` only names `loadMany` in its cache paragraph, which stays true.

### Why (measured)

Measured at `27abd458a8` (PR #32214's final head), with one `DatabaseLoader` holding two packages' rows of the name `helper`, both bound by the `package_id` column alone (`ALPHA` at version 1, `BETA` at version 2). All five types answered identically.

| Probe | `27abd458a8` | this head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `MetadataManager.loadMany(type)` | `[BETA's body, unstamped]` | `[BETA's body, _packageId: BETA]` |
| each item registered back without the boot pass's source skip | **inserts a package-less row** (BETA's body, version 3) | no write |
| real boot pass (`_loadFromFileSystem`), rows | unchanged (R5-A) | unchanged |
| real boot pass, registry slot | the package-less slot `helper`; with a host `packageId`, the host's slot | `BETA`'s slot |
| `get(type, 'helper', ALPHA)` after the boot | **BETA's body** | ALPHA's body |
| `get(type, 'helper', HOST or GAMMA)` after the boot | BETA's body | `undefined` |
| `get(type, 'helper')` after the boot | BETA's body (unstamped, or stamped with the host) | BETA's body, stamped `BETA` (unchanged answer, see finding F1) |
| one holder: `get(type, 'helper')` | ALPHA's body, unstamped | ALPHA's body, stamped `ALPHA` |

### Moved answers (FROM → TO)

FROM is `27abd458a8`; TO is this head. First-party count 0 on every row: only a host that wires a `DatabaseLoader` reaches any of them.

| # | Reader or writer | Case | FROM | TO | Arm | Pin |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `MetadataManager.get(type, name, P)` after the boot pass | P holds no row of the name (the host's `packageId` included) | another package's body | `undefined` | **narrowing** | `database-loader.test.ts` `[#32458]`: "the boot pass registers…", "one holder…" |
| 2 | `MetadataManager.get(type, name, P)` after the boot pass | P holds a row of the name, another package's row was saved last | that other package's body | P's own body | correction | "the boot pass registers…" |
| 3 | `MetadataManager.loadMany(type)` | a row bound by the column alone | its body unstamped | stamped `_packageId` with the column's package | semantic (library) | "two holders — loadMany stamps…" |
| 4 | the boot pass's registry write | the same row | the name's package-less slot, or the host's slot on a host with a `packageId` | the row's own package's slot | correction | "the boot pass registers…" |
| 5 | `MetadataManager.register` of a `loadMany` item without `skipSourceLoader` | two holders | inserts a package-less row at the next version | no write | correction (no refusal) | "two holders — loadMany stamps…" |
| 6 | `DatabaseLoader.save` | body = its row's plus that row's own `_packageId` | a new version and a history row | no write | correction (no refusal) | "a save whose body is its row's…" |
| 7 | `DatabaseLoader.loadManyKeyed` | these five types | entries without `packageId` | entries with the row's `packageId` | additive | covered through rows 3–5 |
| 8 | `MetadataManager.get(type, name)` and `list(type)` after the boot pass, one holder | the item's `_packageId` | absent | the row's package | semantic (library) | "one holder…" |

## Tests

- **Red first.** The new `[#32458]` describe has 23 cases (21 in the first round, 22 in the second). At `27abd458a8` 20 of the first 21 are red; the one that stays green checks that the type list comes from the tree.
- **Ablation, one half at a time.** Each half goes back alone, the rest of the fix stays: `loadMany` limited to `email_template` → 15 of 21 red; `loadManyKeyed`'s `packageId` limited to `email_template` → 15 red; the save gate back on `slot?.member !== undefined` → 10 red (the register-back and the direct-save pins of each type). Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- src`, then 21 of 21 green.
- **Review round 1 (seat contract review, should-fix F1):** the first head read these types through `loadManyKeyed` for every loader, which drops a file-system body it cannot name and a row whose `name` column is empty; `loadMany` returned both. The new case "every body loadMany answered is kept" is red at the first head (`b361d3d33`: 1 failed) and green here. Ablating the stamp helper alone (it returns the bodies unstamped) turns 16 of 22 cases red; restored, 22 of 22 green.
- **Review round 2 (seat contract review, should-fix F3):** the round-1 helper keyed its map by the row's key but looked it up by the body's `name`, so a row keyed `b` whose body says `name: 'a'` was handed on stamped with row `a`'s package. The new case "a body whose name is another row's key is never stamped…" covers both halves of the rule, for every type: row `b` (bound to `BETA` or to none) with body `a` beside row `a` bound to `ALPHA` → `loadMany` answers the stray body unstamped and the boot pass registers only the bare slot `a`, as on `main`; row `a` bound to `ALPHA` with body `z` beside a nameless-column row with body `a` → neither is stamped. Red at `03b714296`. Ablating either half alone (the own-name check, or the one-body check) turns it red; restored, 23 of 23 green. In the first sub-case `loadMany`'s by-name dedupe keeps the stray body, which it read first, and drops `ALPHA`'s, exactly as on `main`; this PR does not move that answer.
- **One-holder tests:** the existing #31699 R4/R5/R7 describes in the same file stay green unchanged, and so does the one-holder case of each type: a bare read answers the unique holder.

## Acceptance notes

- Functions touched: `MetadataManager.loadMany`, `DatabaseLoader.loadManyKeyed`, `DatabaseLoader.save`. #32488, which goes first in the lane, touches `_loadFromFileSystem`, a new `MetadataManager.sourceLoaderOf` next to `loadMany`, and `DatabaseLoader.bindReadRowPackage`.
- Out of scope, reported and not changed: **F1 → filed #32521** (class a, reach: hosts wiring a `DatabaseLoader`, first-party 0). The boot pass primes one row per name for the five unbundled types, because `DatabaseLoader.loadManyKeyed` keeps one row per name (the row saved last). The registry then holds one holder of a two-holder name, so the bare `get(type, name)` answers that holder's body. `loadSlottedDiagnosed`, which would refuse it `409` naming both, is never reached. Evidence: the measurement table above, row `get(type, 'helper')`. The answer is the same at `27abd458a8` and here.

## Verification

Head `99a823e7d`: review round 2's `73b48731a` with `main` `64ce2353af` merged in after #32488 (PR #32544) landed; the merge was clean and the net diff against `main` is still this PR's five files. Each line says which head it ran on.

- **Dispatch gates** (at `73b48731a`; re-running at `99a823e7d`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` over the five changed paths derived 95 commands, and all 95 were run with each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran`: 95 derived, 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. Two first exited 1 and were re-run: `check:dts-closure` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, because the local `@objectstack/metadata` dist had been built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` and so carried no `.d.ts` / `.d.cts`; after a full `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata build` both exit 0. (At `2dd2ecfeb`, two others first exited 3 for the same kind of local reason and were re-run to exit 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, whose pinned fixture the shallow clone lacked, and `check:type-check-debt`, a verify-lock queue timeout.)
- **Dogfood battery** (the `(narrowing)` arm owes it): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under `os-verify-lock`. At `2dd2ecfeb`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 451 passed / 3 skipped (454), Tests 3780 passed / 42 skipped (3822). Re-running at `99a823e7d`.
- **CI on `73b48731a`:** 53 check runs, every one concluded success or skipped, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8 included (the new pins run there).
- **Lint:** `pnpm lint` (whole tree, `--no-inline-config`), exit 0 at `2dd2ecfeb`; since then, eslint on the touched files exit 0. `check-nul-bytes`: OK.
- **`@objectstack/metadata`** at `99a823e7d`: `vitest run` 74 files, 1381 tests passed (the `[#32458]` describe 23 of 23); `tsc --noEmit` exit 0; eslint on the touched files exit 0.
- **Downstream suites**, run at `efd4ea3a6` (the fix on `27abd458a8`, before the `main` merge): objectql 12347 passed, metadata-protocol 22738 passed (36 skipped), runtime 11217 passed (19 skipped), rest 8202 passed (355 skipped). The merge's incoming commits are #32214's own squash and unrelated packages; they were not re-run after it, and the dogfood battery above was.
